title: Control spreadsheet writeback with a workspace admin setting
body: Excel and Google Sheets writeback now requires a workspace admin to enable the **Allow spreadsheet writeback** security setting. See [Write data back to Databricks using the Databricks Excel Add-in](/aws/en/integrations/excel/write-back) and [Write data back to Databricks from Google Sheets](/aws/en/integrations/google-sheets/write-back).
